item.title: Memetic Conversation Cards
item.description: Seemingly sapient conversation cards with a dangerous memetic effect... (seeking greenlight)
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: A set of ever-changing anomalous conversation cards that compel the reader to do whatever the card has written on it- for example, if one said "read this card over and over", the subject would be forced to read the card over and over until the cards are taken from them or they expire.

Central Narrative: A group of researchers testing the capabilities of the SCP after MTF recovery units with memetic resistance read the cards and are forced to do the actions on the cards, requiring a second team to come in. They are located in a house with a family who is also stuck performing the acts described by the cards. The researchers have extensive testing logs in which they test the capabilities of the cards, ending in a scenario where the last card says "Cause a containment breach." The result box says nothing but [DATA EXPUNGED] resulting in ██ casualties. Testing on SCP-XXXX halted indefinitely.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Although the SCP seems harmless to the researchers at first, the cards in the testing log become more and more malicious as time goes on. The cards then convey a message to the researchers, ending in something like I KNOW YOU'RE READING THIS : GET AWAY FROM MY CARDS : [EXPLETIVE REMOVED] YOU : Cause a containment breach at Site-██.

Additional Notes: Any critique of my idea is appreciated. I've reworked a couple of ideas into this so I hope it does well. Again, any criticism is appreciated! Thanks!

item.title: The Evolves (Greenlight)
item.description: The human species is evolving, shortening the bridge between humans and technology by coming two steps closer.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlight: Yes
Page Type: SCP Article
Page Layout: Description and containment procedures of the entity | Conversations with the entity | Description and containment procedures of a deadly virus created by the entity.

Elevator Pitch: A new generation of humanity is on the horizon with the ability to connect to any piece of computerized machinery and manipulate its code to their will through their mind and the foundation has found and contained The First.

The First: Has normal teenager appearances. He is the first person to have been spotted with such abilities. Hacks into the foundation database almost everyday in hope to find someone like him (the foundation is close to developing a software to protect their database). Isn't really cooperative due to being separated from his parents and knows that he will never be able to see them. Hobbies include singing, reading fictional books.

Hook/Attention Grabber: Besides the common ability mentioned above. These "Evolves" have a unique ability. "The First" I want this article on has the unique ability to engineer a virus which attacks on the human brain and shuts it down in 2-3 days. When an infected is in contact with any computer, the virus will inject some of its code which will act as a computer virus capable of taking down the entire NASA Database in a single day.

Additional Notes: I have not started a draft on this yet but will do it as soon as/if I get the greenlights required. Would love as many suggestions, critiques on this as I can get.

item.title: Te Horoi Pai (Seeking Greenlight)
item.description: Second SCP proposal based on a revisited concept.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror, Mystery

+ show block
– hide block

Elevator Pitch: A tube of Petroleum jelly. When ointment is applied to a human, a person's hygiene is enhanced. Prominent symptom manifest in the form of pheromone secretion and irrational compulsion to spread the ointment. Hours after patient zero is infected, the infected encounter amorphous entities. Appearing entities embody subconscious fetishes or extremest fears. They ignore beings lacking pheromone and are hostile to those marked with pheromone.

Central Narrative: On the 9th December, the mysterious disappearance of 25 guests and staff at the Westhaven Luxury Lodge made national headlines. A team of four Field Agents stationed at Nelson, New Zealand take over the investigation and create a cover story.

Field Agents are briefed about the crime scene by the police. Exploring the lodge they find five rooms in the hallway cordoned off by police tape. Foundation agents are alarmed by the crude messages scratched into the Manuka wood and signs glued onto the walls left behind by the lodging's former occupants. Text advertise and revere "a conditioner sent by the gods". Most jarringly, the other remainder of the text read "The knavish resistance were enlightened, now they too relish the heaven-sent scent". Conditioner called "Te Horoi Pai" , translated to Xtreme Conditioner is discovered and placed in containment. All other copies found in the Lodging or within Police custody are confiscated and destroyed.

Testing is conducted, discovering the anomaly's psycho-contagious nature. It's speculated an unknown G.O.I is at hand. A nationwide sweep, extensively covering every hotel, motel and supermarket in New Zealand, yields negative results. A Mobile Taskforce (Called Bad Hair Day) is conceived to monitor the domestic supply chain for wild instances.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Mass disappearance is unheard-of in the 21st century, creating mystery. The anomaly takes place in New Zealand. Testing reveals the ultimate fate of the Lodging's residents. Furthermore, the G.O.I theory is a hypothesis, since Te Horoi Pai is the product name but there is no brand associated nor a manufacturer stated on the bottle. Therefore, the Foundation attempts to contain a contagious SCP with no identified point of origin; an analogy for viral outbreak clusters with no immediate causes.

Additional Notes: This is a submission for my first "canon" SCP, so any form of criticism is appreciated (Bluntness is 100% tolerated but please be constructive).

item.title: The Perpetual Lawnmower
item.description: A lawnmower that perpetually gets faster, till exposed to grass.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking greenlight.
SCP Article.

Elevator Pitch: SCP-XXXX is a lawnmower that perpetually gets faster and doesn't suffer from wind resistance or interact with physical objects, until it comes into contact with grass. When it touches grass it becomes 'real' and suffers the effects of wind resistance from the speed that it is going.

Central Narrative: This is an anomaly created by a new POI, who created this specifically to mow their lawn for them without any effort. This SCP was found moving away from this POI's place of residence at very high speeds, allowing the foundation to get a rough idea to where this POI lives.

Hook: Its a dangerous lawnmower that moves super fast.

item.title: Hive-Mind Wolves
item.description: Wolves that can see through some stuff and not others, as well as creating hostile hive-minds.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror

Page Layout (Optional): Large Special Containment Procedures and Description, as well as a brief addendum, and a video transcript.

Elevator Pitch: A group of three wolves that can see through opaque objects, but cannot see through transparent/translucent objects at all, any person seen by an instance can be elevated into a hostile, collective hive mind, however it has a limited range.

Central Narrative: These wolves can turn entire groups of people into collective hive minds, that are violent, and can cause mass destruction, people can be initiated into the hive mind almost instantly, but it takes 15 minutes out of sight of the instances to exit, requiring some pretty specific methods and tactics to prevent the hive mind from simply walking back into the SCP's line of sight, or allowing the SCP to breach containment entirely.

However, the SCP instances and the members of the hive minds appear to want to destroy the foundation, as those affected have been seen to destroy foundation buildings and locations before they would be held off.

It would be found somewhere in washington after attracting the attention of the foundation as a horde of people started raiding a foundation building, and started to essentialy dismantle and destroy it, before those people would be either kept away by task forces or neutralized to keep away if necessary. Several groups would have to get together to contain the SCP and lock it away in Area-14, in Nevada.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Just the pure speculation of the damage this SCP could do, due to it's ability to turn large masses of people into essentially their own weapon, while maintaining their individual intelligence such as ability to use weaponry and vehicles, as well as that the SCP and the hive minds appear to have a hatred or distaste for The Foundation, and seek to destroy or dismantle it.

Additional Notes: Nothing else much to say here, except, thank you for looking over this, and giving me your critique, and I'll do my best to pay attention.

item.title: J SCP: The Element of Surprise
item.description: It was about time to update the Periodic Table of Elements! Meet SCPnium, the Element of Surprise.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: J SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Joke SCP, Comedy

Page Layout (Optional): Standard SCP page

Elevator Pitch: An incident involving a Scranton Reality Anchor releases a new element into the atmosphere: the Element of Surprise. This element affects the Hume levels on a small area around it, creating unforeseeable results akin to Alchemy (transformation of one element into another, creating life, etc).

Central Narrative: Following the incident researchers notice that their experiments are yielding crazy results. Both super advanced experiments and simple stuff like making grilled cheese present impossible outcomes. The page shows reports of some failed experiments and the comically truncated investigation to understand the phenomenon. Finally they isolate the new element and devise a way to contain it: a multilayered sphere made of random materials that can resist the alterations caused by the Element of Surprise, maintenance includes adding new layers at random intervals to prevent ruptures.

Hook/Attention-Grabber:

  • Cartoon-like humor with the failed experiments
  • New element that can be used in future articles and tales

Additional Notes: I don't have a lot of expertise on Joke SCPs but this idea seemed worth investing on. I'm open to all crits and suggestions :)

item.title: IMAGINE YOU WERE THERE: Potential SCP
item.description: A sadistic man tells stories of violence; people who listen to the end suffer the fate of the characters
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror

Page Layout (Optional): Containment, Description, Discovery, Incident Reports, Interview

Elevator Pitch: A sadistic man tells stories of violence and death. People who listen are entranced. However, as the story goes on, listeners start to show signs of physical trauma. When the man finishes his story, any wounds inflicted on the characters in the story appear on the listener, often killing them.

Central Narrative:

The concept is introduced in the Containment Procedures and Description. The SCP is relatively easy to contain, except that his anomalous abilities increase over time unless he is given a D-class to tell a story to. If he is not sated within 8 days, his anomalous abilities begin to work over video, radio, and recordings. If he cannot tell anyone a story in 15 days, he will begin to project mental images of torture and killing into the minds of people outside his containment. After 21 days, this starts to cause minor but real physical damage to those affected. After 28 days, he mentally projects his image of agony onto everyone within several kilometers, which kills most of those affected.

The SCP was discovered and contained after a series of anomalous murders in Tokyo. The SCP seems to understand more about its powers than the Foundation does, and has caused a number of incidents and containment breaches.

In an interview, the SCP recounts its childhood psychopathy, its path to becoming a serial killer, and how it attained its anomalous abilities.

item.title: Pep-Talk Sticky Notes
item.description: Sticky notes that, when you take one, calm you down.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlight: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article
Elevator Pitch: A sticky note pad that is only useable by personnel currently experiencing negative emotions. When said personnel take one, the message on the note viewable only to them calms them down and leaves them feeling content for a period of three minutes afterward. When the three minutes are up, the subject is left in a neutral state. The messages are reported as upbeat and encouraging.

Central Narrative: It logs how the anomaly is used during testing and ends with a log in which the notepad manifests a secondary anomalous property. It also logs the potential uses of the notepad.

Hook/Attention Grabber I plan the Containment Procedures to be attention-grabbing, with them going something like As SCP-XXXX poses no threat to the security and safety of Site-XX and its personnel, SCP-XXXX is allowed to be freely used whenever it manifests contained in a lock-protected drawer in Dr. XXXXX's office. Also, I plan to put an interview log in which the notepad manifests in the middle of a stressful interview and then manifests to the interviewee after failing the interview miserably.

Additional Notes: I know it's another item SCP, but they work best for my writing style. Also, I want to write this one to be easy to understand for people who have never read an SCP before.

All criticism is appreciated! Thanks!

item.title: EVER EVASIVE BUBBLE!!! IN NEED OF GREENLIGHT!!!
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: scp article

Genre (Optional): Horror

Elevator Pitch: This scp is a bubble with a folded note inside of it. the outside of the note is a face that looks like it is sleeping. the scp seeming to subconsciously avoid all forms of touching. Inside of the folded note may be a memetic symbol, a ground breaking discovery, or a piece of information so horrible, it could shatter even the most sturdy minds.

Central Narrative: This scp was found in a circus that came to [REDACTED] Wisconsin one in a while. A researcher was taking his kids to that circus one day and there was a sign that read ,"EVER-ELUSIVE BUBBLE!!! COME TRY TO POP IT!" the researcher, thinking it would be a great first circus game for them to try, took them into the tent. The kids jumped at the bubble, trying to pop it, and each time, the bubble unnaturally evaded the attempt. The research had called his site director and told him about it. Later after the circus closed, an MTF squad circled the perimeter and closed the circus down. The reason they told the local police and the circus members was because of "safety" and "Drug use". The circus is now a private site of the foundation. several cameras and MTF members have been placed around the perimeter. A monitor room has been placed just outside of the site to keep track of the property.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The note inside of the bubble could have anything in it.

item.title: The chamber of eternity
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Drama/Emotional

Page Layout (Optional): Regular SCP page, with Containment Procedures, Descriptions, And addendums

Elevator Pitch: A Chamber is found off the coast of Great Britain covered in strange runes the Foundation can't translate. This chamber allows for short-distance multiversal travel, connecting to around 4 other universes. One person is required to link themselves to this chamber, and then other instances of them can travel through into the present reality. Fondation uses this to connect to other Foundation's, and using their information to collect anomalies before they become an issue.

Central Narrative:

+ Yesyes click on me
- Here you go !!!!!

A junior researcher with a strong background in multiversal studies is selected to link themself to this chamber, by entering inside and connecting them self to other versions of themself. Other foundation instances of this junior researcher come through, and they provide valuable insight into the several SCP's this reality did not possess. The other instances include
1. A site director.
2. a very high ranking officer in the foundation's military division, and is in far better shape then the main junior researcher,
3. Still a junior scientist, but from a universe where the Foundation is on great diplomatic terms with the Wanderer's Library, so this version has various thaumaturgic capabilities.
4. The only one is not a foundation member, but is an avid Parawatch user, and her insight is useful enough to keep around, albeit with the caveat that she will be amentisied before returning to her home plane.
Over time, The main junior researcher reports a decreased emotionally stability, and requests various times to be released from the project, citing "These other versions of me are way smarter and i'm just a burden on studying this project." His requests are not given. All signs point to the main version of this researcher snapping, and then the version that isn't a foundation member is shown trying to take out the one with the thaumaturgy, which obviously doesn't go well. Using the help of the other versions translate's the runes to say "May your strong leaders enter, and the strongest leader exit.”

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The containment procedures will mention how SCP-XXXX-1 goes through several physiological evaluations through out the course of the chamber being active, and different versions of themself are to be kept apart. They will be written to show a lot of precaution for a
Thaumiel object.

Additional Notes: The ancient group that created this object will be present in every alternative reality, but not the main one. This chamber was used by the king’s of this country to prove they were the strongest possible version of themselves.

item.title: Idea Critique: Staff conflicted morals on a anomalous site.
item.description: SCP Idea about conflicting morals for foundation staff.
item.content:encoded:
Greenlight Status: Seeking

Page Type: SCP Document (and accompanying tale about prison break after greenlight)

Premise: The premise is about an anomalous village filled with people (SCP-XXXX-1 or -1s) that are generally harmless inside, but if they get out they could be dangerous (how they are dangerous is to be determined, but not world-ending - maybe just dangerous to the civilian populace). The staff are instructed to not sympathize, but are not told what will happen if they do.

Hook: The catch and twist of the story is how the staff fight each other from the ones who want to let the -1s out, and the ones who want to keep them contained. There will probably be a separate tale about both sides of the conflict if this is greenlighted.

Basically about conflicting morals for foundation staff, and who is the "bad guy" - letting the -1s out, or keeping them contained.

item.title: The Goddess Fertility Engine
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article and subsequent Tale if more information is requested

Page Layout: The article will open by stating the containment of the SCP is of high importance, but failure to capture will not result in consequences beyond the lack of benefits of the SCP.

Elevator Pitch: The SCP is a machine of unknown and anomalous origin which houses an apparatus to restrain a human woman. Once inside this apparatus the machine’s anamolous properties take affect and give the human woman increased size as well as reality altering abilities. The machine appears only in the result of a K-class event, and the foundation is unsure whether it causes such events, or is guaranteed to appear in every instance of a K-class event or only certain varieties. The woman inside the machine is basically a “goddess” although in a very loose sense, capable of reproduction without a male counterpart, as well as a variety of properties that allow the woman to manipulate matter, environments, weather etc. It appears acts as a sort of life engine for a new world once the earth is inhabitable.
Central Narrative: The narrative centers around the foundations lack of knowledge of its capabilities, and if containment or capture would even cause harm to the earth itself. The foundation only knows about the machine and the transformation process through the reports from SCP-507, and through numerous different exposures and sightings from 507 more information is revealed, although much of the process is still mysterious, leading to the foundation drawing conclusions and pour resources into claiming the machine.

Hook/Attention-Grabber:
I think the vagueness of the scp makes it interesting. It’s one of those items that the foundation knows it must contain due to the value of such machinery, while at the same time not even quite understanding what the machine even is other than a possible fresh start for man kind.

Additional Notes:
This is a very rough explanation. I have a draft worked out already but don’t know how to explain it in the short length of 400 words. Thanks for taking your time to read my draft!

item.title: My SCP Idea
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: SCP-XXXX is an alien object that orbits the sun which sucks 0.2-3% of it's energy
every decade. The Foundation would try to stop it so Earth doesn't become a frozen hellhole.

Central Narrative: The SCP Foundation would try to reduce the energy intake of the alien base that was sent to the solar system because of an energy crisis with several different ways. The story would take over a span of 35 years with the Foundation enlisting the help of the United Nations to stop the anomalous object.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: If the foundation were to destroy the object, the Alien civilization could die out which brings out the the ethical question for the Foundation of 'do we let them die to save ourselves'?

Additional Notes: I would like assistance on expanding this idea further, and if there's any issues with it, I would appreciate if you would tell me what's wrong with it.

item.title: (Seeking Greenlight) The Ancient Gateway
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights:** Yes.

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Horror/Comedy

Elevator Pitch: An ancient interdimensional gateway with an unknown origin located somewhere in Antarctica's underground, which leads to a world where lies a cosmic entity. However, with the mind of a kind-hearted average joe.

Central Narrative:

+ show block
– hide block

SCP-XXXX appears to be an old gateway with an unknown origin. The gateway is approximately 8,849 meters constructed out of unknown solid materialize and has unknown symbols are written all over it. Any individual who walks into SCP-XXXX would lead them to a realm of endless cosmos where an entity whose size is inapplicably held. The anomaly is designated as SCP-XXXX-01. SCP-XXXX-01 appears to be an inorganic entity with no human facial features, no signs of hair, eyes, nose, mouth, or eyes. Its body has entirely different physiology that is presumed to be made out of non-existent type matters called "cosmic matters".

SCP-XXXX-01 shows no signs of hostility is capable of speech, shown to have unique knowledge. It would be able to remain patiently/motionless in one place without feeling any urges/aggression over many years1. However, sometimes it would leave its place2, and will not feel disturbed if any individuals are there to observe it.

SCP-XXXX was first discovered when a group of individuals exploring Antarctica has reported to the authorities that while in the middle of finding shelter to avoid an upcoming snowstorm, they'd found a cave with a passage that leads deep down to its location. As this was brought to the Foundation, they've deployed a group of agents, MTF-Twilight-10, codename "Broken Stellers," was deployed with the duty is to accompany all of the witnesses out and monitor/guard the area.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: This SCP was inspired by a cosmic being named Venrensorys. But with a few aspects added and some changes.

Additional Notes: Draft is work in progress.


As a courtesy to our readers on mobile devices, please collapse long posts. ~Zyn
Footnotes
1. Stated in the interview, it can wait patiently for even eternities.
2. Stated in the interview.

item.title: SCP concept-The ring of mimicry
item.description: A ring that turns its container into a hostile object
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: its a simple ring that when stored in a container for a given time, it will transform that object into a mimic until taken out. Its containment procedures prevent mimicry by moving it between boxes frequently.

Central Narrative: The ring, while easy to contain, can be catastrophic if not watched after. It does not have a size limit on what it can animate. That means, if given time, the ring could animate the entire facility (key word is given time, it would take decades for the ring to achieve that). Thus the ring has many re-containment procedures and fail-safes to prevent that.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: For this idea, I tried to turn the whole box idea on its head. The whole "if you put it in a box and it stays there, then its safe", I thought about if you put it in a box and then the box tried to kill you, what would it be?

Additional Notes: This is my second idea for an SCP, I'm still very new to this so my clinical tone and ideas may not be satisfactory, I'm open to all critique as I'm here purely to improve.

item.title: Another Day for the (Logistics Department)

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Layout (Optional): N/A

Elevator Pitch: Courier Gabriel travels to deliver an unknown SCP to Site-19 with complications along the way.

Central Narrative: Gabriel starts off loading the SCP into his delivery truck, noting not to ask questions on what's inside. Everything goes smoothly (agents with him), until they are attacked by an unknown GOI. The agents are lost or killed and Gabriel must finish this one-day delivery with guns pointed at him in every direction with the added fact that an unknown SCP is inside and he has no idea what it does.

All of them will have a tad of workplace comedy, danger, and horror to whatever they're dealing with. It's Ironic how "Another Day" in the Foundation can usually mean life or death, no matter who you are.

Additional Notes: As me anything, I'll answer. I always love to hear a good crit about how to improve. Be blunt. Bash as hard as you can. You'll find I have a thick skull.

item.title: City of normacy
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Page Layout: Two standard SCP pages, one outdated for the zone with its discovery and test logs and one for the anomalous human.

Elevator Pitch: The Foundations discovers an area that negates anomalous effects and memories or instructions relating to the anomalous, making them try a more indirect approach to learn about the anomaly which would lead to them to discover that it is caused unknowingly by a human with interest in the supernatural.

Central Narrative: The Foundation discovers an area capable of overriding any anomalous effect, records, or memories related to anomalies or groups of interest after they lose contact with an operative who had remained in the area and find him days later with no memories of his mission or any event related to the Foundation. When investigating the area, other operatives and equipment end up being affected, at which point the Foundation makes the first designation and prepares to investigate in greater depth only to find that all orders or influence are lost in the area, preventing the evacuation of the city ​​or direct communication with its inhabitants while they are inside; limiting himself to observing the area from afar, interviewing anyone leaving the city and determining the boundaries of the area.
During the course of the investigation, the Foundation determines the limits of this anomaly, noting that it varies its position with the passage of time but always maintains the same size, which ends up revealing the person to whom the area is connected. Due to the restrictions given by the anomaly, the Foundation uses his online presence, records, and surveillance to learn about the SCP, discovering his interest in the supernatural.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The research on the limits of the anomaly through unusual means by the Foundation and the discovery of the human cause and its implications.

Additional Notes: I want some advice on how to make the most of the build-up to finish up the article.
